for path, line, repeats, size in [('hello.txt', b'Hello from a formal Task.\n', 1, 26), ('notes.txt', b'Notes from a formal Task.\n', 8192, 212992)]:

    assert len(actual) == size

    assert not actual.startswith(b'\xef\xbb\xbf')
    assert actual.decode('utf-8').encode('utf-8') == actual
    print({'path': path, 'actual_bytes': len(actual), 'committed_bytes': len(committed), 'repetitions': repeats, 'LF_only': True, 'BOM': False, 'all_bytes_equal_expected': True})"
